subject.title: Tool call observability: input sanitization, error categorization, and context writeback

question: Should the remaining work be a metadata-only tool/writeback audit contract, an opt-in content-capture extension, or be folded into the broader AI safety observability taxonomy?
rationale: The remaining request crosses a privacy boundary: useful writeback/error observability could become sensitive-content persistence unless maintainers choose the durable schema, redaction level, exporter mapping, and transcript compatibility contract.

options.title: Define Metadata-Only Contract
options.body: Add closed metadata fields for tool error codes and writeback classes/counts without raw file, message, memory, diff, argument, result, or error text, then implement focused follow-up PRs.

options.title: Allow Opt-In Content Capture
options.body: Permit richer writeback/error content only behind the existing explicit diagnostic content-capture policy and document the privacy tradeoff.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Observability
options.body: Defer this issue's remaining work to the broader AI safety/quality observability issue so tool, memory, and safety telemetry share one taxonomy.

recommendation.title: Define Metadata-Only Contract
recommendation.body: Add closed metadata fields for tool error codes and writeback classes/counts without raw file, message, memory, diff, argument, result, or error text, then implement focused follow-up PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the related metadata-only audit-ledger direction and is the clearest product/security boundary owner among the identified related people.
